headline: Heavy freight is slow freight — FLOOR BOSS now prices by weight
lede: The freight line got its sibling rate-card: parcels pack LIGHT, STANDARD or HEAVY, heavies pay up to triple the per-box freight on a full trailer — and the dock takes twice as long to load them. A LOCAL×HEAVY crate pays exactly what a LONG-HAUL×LIGHT crate pays, so the pad's little steel H badge is a real dispatch decision, not decoration.

notes.text: Weight classes roll on their own seeded stream — the order book and #1927's destination tiers replay byte-identically; both streams are now golden-pinned for 8 seeds.

The session's catch: #1927's destination ladder was secretly giving REGIONAL ~72% of parcels and LOCAL ~14% — its gate only checked LOCAL>LONG. Bands corrected to the documented 58/28/14, mix gates now pin the FULL ordering, and a new mutant proves the sentinel can fail.
The floor got new tells: steel H badges and load bars on the pad, a low thud when a heavy crate lands aboard, and HEAVY xN named on the till. Autopilot shifts win 14/15 seeds now (was 13/15).
Next up for FLOOR BOSS: QA's polish pass (#1877) now carries badge-legibility and dock-countdown items; the shelf's never-dry scan keeps running after every ship.
